Data Mobilisation Priorities

Actionable Targets for Closing Biodiversity Data Gaps

gbifgaps

April 17, 2026

Overview

This report synthesises the gap analysis into actionable priorities for data mobilisation. It identifies specific spatial cells, taxonomic groups, and institutional gaps that should be targeted to improve GBIF data completeness.

Recommended Actions

Priority Detail
Spatial: Fill zero-coverage cells 33 grid cells have never been surveyed.
Temporal: Resurvey stale cells 327 cells have not been surveyed in over 5 years.
Taxonomic: Close species coverage gaps 54,538 backbone species have no GBIF records.
Threatened: Monitor CR and EN species 60 CR/EN species lack any GBIF occurrence data.
Sensitive: Assess data availability 185 species have restricted coordinates (5–50 km generalisation).
Infrastructure: Diversify data sources 337 of 4,988 grid cells depend on a single publisher.
